Dukljan unique Medieval era Light Cavalry class unit that replaces the Courser. 1 [ICON_Range] Range. Becomes a naval ranged unit when embarked. Can melee attack when on land, cannot melee attack when at sea. +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement when embarked. Naval Melee and Naval Ranged class units can Coastal Raid if adjacent to a Gusar.

Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Autocephalous Church, unique to Duklja.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Housing] Housing and [ICON_Faith] Faith. +2 Loyalty. +2 [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet points per turn. Gain standard adjacency for various yields relative to the type of adjacent specialty district, this becomes major adjacency with Nationalism. +15 HP healing for friendly religious units on the tile that has not attacked during the turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A city can only have one Autocephalous Church. Autocephalous Church tiles cannot be swapped. Cannot be built adjacent to another Autocephalous Church.
